title: Vegetable and Fruit Juice, 100% Juice, High Vitamin C

content.title: About
content.content: Vegetable and fruit juice is a 100% natural juice made from a blend of fresh vegetables and fruits. It contains a wide range of vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants, with an especially high vitamin C content (4903 mg per litre), making it an excellent way to support the immune system.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The juice is produced without added sugar, preservatives, or artificial flavors.
Combining vegetables and fruits provides a broader nutrient profile than single‑fruit juices.
Vitamin C remains stable thanks to cold‑pressing and rapid pasteurization.
The juice is often used in sports nutrition for faster post‑workout recovery.
Its high acidity can enhance iron absorption from plant‑based foods.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C is a powerful antioxidant that supports immune function and collagen synthesis.

items.title: Hydration support
items.content: With over 90% water content, the juice helps maintain the body’s fluid balance.

items.title: Source of potassium
items.content: Potassium supports normal heart and muscle function and helps regulate blood pressure.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Phytonutrients from the vegetables and fruits help neutralize free radicals.

items.title: Digestive aid
items.content: Natural dietary fiber in the juice promotes regular bowel movements.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity may cause discomfort for people with gastritis or acid reflux.

items.title: Allergy to ingredients
items.content: The blend may contain fruits or vegetables that trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although no sugar is added, natural fruit sugars can raise the glycemic index.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: Large doses of vitamin C may affect the efficacy of certain drugs, such as anticoagulants.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink the juice chilled in small servings throughout the day. It can be added to smoothies, used as a base for cocktails, or drizzled over salads for extra flavor and nutrition.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the juice in the refrigerator at 2‑4 °C in its original container. Once opened, consume within 3‑5 days. Discard if the colour, smell, or taste changes.
